Dear Mazhar,
Thank you very much for your kind email and follow-up.
As discussed over the past few days, we went live with DMM offer from 5th Aug, But after that we faced several market challenges around the DMM route deal, where we started  taking additional actions from our side to maximize the opportunity and deliver the strongest possible results.
The key challenges were:
The market was having a very aggressive pricing from other players as shared on our discussion.
While we appreciated the 5% exclusive discount, we felt a stronger discount level could have created a greater customer impact and further improved conversion. Which we are keeping this negotiation for our future route deals.
Despite these challenges, we highly value the exclusivity, support, and commitment from you in providing us with this route deal. And to strengthen the offer from a customer perspective, we did additional internal investment where we see improvements from 14 August, which will continue till end of Aug as the campaign perioud.
DMM/DXB & DXB/DMM - MTD daily booked segments (By booking Date):
As this was a single-route deal, our activation was mainly focused on our CRM channels, supported by selected paid advertising. I have attached a few examples of the campaign communications for your reference.
We are looking forward to working together on more exclusive route deals, covering a wider range of routes. A broader offering would help us build an even stronger internal business case with our marketing teams and enable us to secure greater visibility and investment to further push flynas overall.
Thank you again for your continued partnership and support.
Best Regards,
Mohammad Nabil Dodin
Senior Airline Manager - Saudi Arabia
  Dubai Media City, United Arab Emirates

Dear Mazhar,
As discussed, I acknowledge the previous email communication with your team and truly appreciate their immediate support in increasing the discount from 5% to 10%. My last email to you was specifically related to our upcoming campaign, which will be executed separately as a focused sales push across our Saudi channels.
During the campaign period (7th till 10th Jul) we will focus on the specific destination segment from Saudi Arabia:
Europe (Including your new Summer destinations)
Homebound (Egypt, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Jordan)
Far East 
UAE and Saudi domestic routes
I am attaching the full marketing plan and campaign strategy, outlining how we plan to promote XY more aggressively and drive stronger visibility, conversion, and sales contribution during the campaign period. Overall, for ex-Saudi traffic, we are targeting not less than +60% growth versus the current daily trend of XY.
To maximize the impact and simplify execution for both teams, I would highly appreciate your support in extending an aggressive discount to the mentioned regions, including domestic routes.
Thank you in advance for your support, and I look forward to your feedback.
Best Regards,
Mohammad Nabil Dodin
